fields.name: Barbell Bench Press
fields.description: The go-to exercise for building pectoral, shoulder, and triceps strength.

fields.name: Barbell Squat
fields.description: Considered the foundational, total-lower-body movement for developing quads, glutes, and hamstrings.

fields.name: Deadlift
fields.description: A premier compound lift that builds massive strength in the back, glutes, and hamstrings.

fields.name: Treadmill Running/Walking
fields.description: The most popular cardiovascular exercise for endurance, weight loss, and warm-ups.

fields.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
fields.description: A staple for targeting the side shoulders (deltoids) for upper body aesthetics.

fields.name: Pull-ups/Lat Pulldowns
fields.description: Essential exercises for strengthening the lats and building a wider back.

fields.name: Leg Press
fields.description: A popular machine exercise for targeting the legs (quads and glutes) while providing more back support than a squat.

fields.name: Cable Row/Barbell Row
fields.description: A standard movement for building back thickness and improving posture.

fields.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
fields.description: A common, effective isolation exercise for developing the bicep muscles.

fields.name: Plank
fields.description: A staple core exercise used for improving abdominal strength, stability, and posture.
